title: Backups
unavailable: Backups are not available in this session.
noDest: Choose a disk or folder to start backing up.
destMissing: The backup disk is not connected
destHelp: An external disk (ext4 recommended) or a folder. Backups are stored in LordOS-Copias.
noLinks: no hard links: every backup takes full space
noDisks: No external disks mounted. Connect one or choose a folder.
retention: Keeps every backup from the last 24 hours, one per day for the past month and one per week before that. When the disk fills up, the oldest ones are deleted.
priority: Backups run at the lowest CPU and disk priority so they don't slow down the desktop.
excludeHelp: Folders in your home that are not backed up. The cache and the Trash are always excluded.
emptyBody: There are no backups on this destination yet. Click “Back Up Now” to make the first one.
restoreAllKeep: Everything is brought back as it was on {when}. Files that changed since then are kept alongside with “(restored)” in the name: nothing is lost.
restoreAllReplace: Everything is brought back as it was on {when}, replacing the files that changed since then. Newer files are not deleted.
deleteBody: The backup from {when} will be deleted. The others are not affected.
lockedLine: Backups are encrypted: enter the passphrase in Settings to continue
encOffHelp: Encrypt the backups on this destination with a passphrase (XChaCha20-Poly1305). File names are not encrypted.
encWarn: If you lose the passphrase the backups cannot be recovered. It can only be turned on for a destination without backups.
encShort: The passphrase must have at least 8 characters
encLocked: The backups on this destination are encrypted. Enter the passphrase to back up and restore during this session; it is not saved to disk.
encOn: Encrypted and unlocked for this session
notify.lockedBody: Enter the passphrase so scheduled backups can continue.
